title: Stomped targets come back where they swayed to
description: With 3 seconds left in the Moon Room, the player runs off the ledges and lands on three swaying targets in a row. Each comes back as a UFO above the spot where it was stomped, worth 3, the middle and far ones well left of their own paths, before the last bounce takes him onto the Spikes.
